correctness.rationale: Auditor re-ran inputs/artifacts/verify.py: all five primals reflexive (facet distances all 1, unique interior lattice point origin, counts 5-9), all five duals reflexive, and both exact triangulations agree on all ten volumes: (4,64),(6,54),(8,48),(10,42),(12,36) with products 256,324,384,420,432. Independently recomputed: P4 determinant -4 -> Vol 4; translated P4* determinant (-4)^3 -> 64; primal base normalized areas 3,4,5,6 (bipyramid doubling -> 6,8,10,12); dual prism-base areas 9,7,6 (x6 -> 54,42,36); P8* cube [-1,1]^3 Vol 48; P4 vertex sum (0,0,0) = centroid/Santalo point; P8 centrally symmetric; Euclidean conversions 64/9,9,32/3,35/3,12 correct (M/36). Absolute-minimality corollaries correctly reduce to cited theorems (Chen et al. 2605.09334 general 64/9 bound; Iriyeh-Shibata symmetric 32/3 bound) applied to verified witness values, with equality-case attribution cited not reproved. One-sided bounds Vol*>=256/V (384/V symmetric) are direct rearrangements of those cited universal lower bounds. Scope honestly limited: DRAFT explicitly disclaims slice completeness and slice-global dual-volume maximality, so no overclaim. No boundary error: origin-fan triangulation is valid because reflexivity (0 strictly interior) was checked, and the vertex-fan cross-check agrees.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp: nearest priors supply only adjacent general facts. Kreuzer-Skarke (hep-th/9805190) classifies the 4319 and supplies primal vertices, not facet-derived dual volumes/products or slice extremals. Balletti-Kasprzyk-Nill (1611.02455) gives a general Sylvester-sequence upper bound on dual volume sharp at a simplex dual, no Vol<=12 slice table or minimizers. Chen et al. (2605.09334 + 2605.13795) prove general 3D Mahler lower bounds 64/9 and symmetric 32/3 with equality characterization, no lattice-reflexive slice census or small-volume explicit minimizer table. Batyrev (alg-geom/9310003) gives general polar-duality mirror theory, no volume spectra. Bao et al. (2109.09602) predicts volume/dual volume/reflexivity by ML with accuracies, not an exact certified table. Live arXiv searches confirm the gap: 'Mahler product reflexive polytope' hits only an unrelated Mahler-measure paper (2507.09303); 'dual volume reflexive' hits only 2109.09602 and 1611.02455; 'Mahler product lattice polytope' hits only a discrete-Legendre-transform paper (2405.18104) about cross-polytopes, none publishing the five-row exact dual-volume/product table or the reflexive simplex/octahedron Mahler-witness identification. Primal volume alone does not determine dual volume/product, so facet-dual construction is a genuine computation, not mechanical transcription. Internal SCOPE029 (primal {4,6,8,10,12}+h*) and SCOPE037 (2D Mahler spectrum) are disjoint in invariant/dimension.

value.rationale: Judging the strongest self-contained headline separately from the unfinished census: the five-row exact table plus two absolute Mahler minimizers is a rigorously established exact invariant of specific natural objects. Objects motivated before computation (reflexive polytopes = Batyrev/KS duality-closed class; Vol<=12 = Lagarias-Ziegler-finiteness-parameter slice and established SCOPE029 small-volume regime; Mahler product = Mahler/BKN program functional). Values not known or mechanically implied (dual volumes 64,54,48,42,36 require independent facet-dual construction; primal volume does not determine dual). Future researcher could need the precise facts: P4 (256=64/9 Euclidean) as the concrete reflexive equality case of the newly proved 3D Mahler conjecture and P8 (384=32/3) as the symmetric equality case, plus the three companion prism products, as citable benchmark/mirror-pair inputs for toric Fano / polymake-Normaliz pipelines. Within the value-axis leniency for exact invariants of natural objects, this is a narrow datum (five rows, not a general theorem) but motivated, non-obvious, and retrievable — not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny unmotivated gain, or unexplained enumeration. The incomplete census is described honestly (no completeness or slice-global dual-max claim), which does not erase the headline result.
